perceive|p_alice.trace: carrying boards with Bram until it was dark
perceive|p_alice.means: he does not talk while he works and I liked that

perceive|p_alice.trace: standing in the street with my hands full of nothing
perceive|p_alice.means: I still cannot be near the market after dark

perceive|p_bram.trace: the table came out square, which it had no right to
the beams went first, then the roof came in
perceive|p_bram.means: we put it back up by spring

perceive|p_bram.trace: green timber, and everyone said so for a year
perceive|p_bram.means: it holds, whatever it smells like

perceive|p_carol.trace: watching it from the hill road and not going down
perceive|p_carol.means: that was when I understood I could leave

perceive|p_david.trace: they ate outside and I went home early
